verdicts.fix: مَا is used before a noun. After it, the i of اِسْم drops: mā smuk.
verdicts.reason: مَا has no initial a; what happens is the waṣla: the i of (i)smuk is not said after the long ā of mā. The current note describes the elision the wrong way round. The kasra on the waṣl alif of اِسْم in a quoted word is the course convention.
